data.name: Crisanta
data.gender_notes: Crisanta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Crisanta is derived from the Spanish words 'cris' meaning 'Christ' and 'anta' meaning 'Santa'. It is a beautiful name that represents the deep spiritual connection between Christ and the Holy Mother. In Christian tradition, Crisanta is a name that signifies faith, devotion, and the love of God. The name Crisanta carries the meaning “Christ and Santa” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Crisanta usually hope their child will grow to embody christ and santa and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of the union between Christ and the Virgin Mary.
data.etymology: Crisanta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Christ and Santa.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Crisanta total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: קריסנטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קריסנטה הוא נגזר משורש יווני ומתורגם כפרח זהב או ניקוד שמיימי שמן, המסמל את היופי והערך הרוחני הגבוה של הנושא בשם זה, בהקשר של המסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Κρυσάνθα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κρυσάνθα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'χρυσός' (χρυσάν) που σημαίνει χρυσό και 'ἄνθος' (anthos) που σημαίνει λουλούδι. Συμβολίζει την πνευματική ομορφιά και την υψηλή αξία εντός της χριστιανικής παράδοσης, αντανακλώντας την πνευματική λαμπρότητα και την αγιότητα.

in_latin.name: Crisanta
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Crisanta derivatur ex radicibus Graecis, significans florem aureum vel ecclesiasticam dignitatem, quae pulchritudinem et spiritualem excellentiam eius qui hoc nomine donatur, exprimit. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen habetur in honore virtutum et donorum caelestium.

in_english.name: Crisanta
in_english.meaning: Golden Flower, Heavenly Blossom of Spiritual Beauty

It symbolizes spiritual beauty, honor, and high virtues within the Christian tradition. Historically, names like Crisanta were chosen to reflect the desired spiritual qualities and aspirations for the child, embodying the values of faith and purity.

The name can serve as a constant reminder to individuals to keep their faith strong and to seek the guidance of both Christ and the Virgin Mary in their daily lives. Crisanta is a name that inspires a deep connection to the divine and a sense of peace and comfort in the knowledge that God is always with us.

It symbolizes the belief in the power of divine intervention and the hope for a fresh start, imbued with the grace of God.
